modules.name: Payload
modules.source:
Private Items() As Long
Public Values As Variant
Public Sub Fill()
    ReDim Items(1 To 2, 1 To 2)
    Items(1, 1) = 11
    Items(1, 2) = 12
    Items(2, 1) = 21
    Items(2, 2) = 22
    ReDim Preserve Items(1 To 2, 1 To 3)
End Sub
Public Property Get Matrix() As Variant
    Matrix = Items
End Property
Public Sub PutItem(ByVal row As Long, ByVal column As Long, ByVal value As Long)
    Items(row, column) = value
End Sub
Public Function GetItem(ByVal row As Long, ByVal column As Long) As Long
    GetItem = Items(row, column)
End Function

modules.name: Api
modules.source:
Public Function RunProbe() As String
    Dim ws As Object, data As Payload, copied As Variant
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
    Set data = New Payload
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Range("I1").Value2 = data.GetItem(1, 1)
    ws.Range("I2").Value2 = Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    data.Fill
    data.PutItem 2, 3, 29
    ws.Range("A1:C2").Value2 = data.Matrix
    copied = ws.Range("A1:C2").Value2
    data.Values = copied
    ws.Range("E1:G2").Value2 = data.Values
    RunProbe = "ok"
End Function
